label: The dataset, every figure a question
caption: One screen holds every joint's range, where the tool goes and which way it points; the dock lists all 54 trajectories until you click a cell.

label: Click a q×qd cell: who made it
caption: A click on shoulder_pan's q 0–20°, qd 0–15°/s cell writes a chip, frames the cell, fades cells nobody in the answer visits, and the dock lists the 8 trajectories that made it.

label: AND a tool pixel
caption: On Tool position the faded pixels show where those 8 never went; clicking a pixel ANDs a second chip and the answer narrows to the one trajectory that does both.

label: Holes: who comes closest
caption: Holes paints reachable pixels no trajectory visits amber and pins the three emptiest spots; clicking pin 1 ranks the 8 shoulder_pan trajectories by how close they pass (a nearest-pixel search), with a line to each one's nearest pixel.

label: Drill in, open in Rerun
caption: A row opens that trajectory beside the dataset: its cells in ink over the faded dataset, its q and qd over time, and Open in Rerun, which shows the command it ran with a Copy button.
